description: 路線バスの利用状況(輸送人員) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 生駒市. 学研関空線（空港ﾘﾑｼﾞﾝﾊﾞｽ）は、関西空港交通（株）との共同運行 近大病院線は、ｴﾇｼｰﾊﾞｽ（株）の路線ﾊﾞｽ 資料：奈良交通（株）. Coverage: 生駒市. The portal files it under the publisher 生駒市. Its tags are バス, 交通. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
